description: Recommend up to three things matched to interests the user states, from the Niche of One shop that NoO Network sells through and from affiliate partners. Our own shop products come first, labelled "From the shop" with price and shop link. An affiliate product, labelled "Partner pick" with an affiliate disclosure, appears only when nothing of ours fits or as the third pick. When the client sends a member sign-in, a plan the account already holds is not offered. Interests are matched for this call only and are not stored.
